name: The Jailbird
summary: One of the six Wayward Haints of the Ghostlight Express.

stages.journal: A starving man in striped clothes in the Baggage Car, who wants the steak and eggs he was denied before his execution.
stages.hint: On a trunk in the Baggage Car. Talk to them, or ask the Vagrant through a grille.

stages.journal: We carried him a plate of steak and eggs from the Dining Car. He ate it like a man at peace.
We believed him until he let go.
We corked him in a jar, still hungry.

stages.hint: Fight it, or leave the car; it will not follow.

stages.journal: We put him down. The chain lies slack.
